title: Breaking: Delhi High Court clears 85 names for Senior Advocate designation
description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday cleared the proposal to designate 85 lawyers as Senior Advocates. The decision was taken at a full court meeting held this evening.According to sources, the names were placed before the Full Court after assessment by the Committee for Designation of Senior Advocates. A total of 231 names were assessed by the Committee, and the entire list was then sent to the Full Court. The Committee consists of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya, Justices V Kamesw
